query: Semiparametric Estimates of the Relation Between Weather and Electricity Sales

record.title: Semiparametric Estimates of the Relation Between Weather and Electricity Sales
record.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
record.abstract: A nonlinear relationship between electricity sales and temperature is estimated using a semiparametric regression procedure that easily allows linear transformations of the data. This accommodates introduction of covariates, timing adjustments due to the actual billing schedules, and serial correlation. The procedure is an extension of smoothing splines with the smoothness parameter estimated from minimization of the generalized cross-validation criterion introduced by Craven and Wahba (1979). Estimates are presented for residential sales for four electric utilities and are compared with models that represent the weather using only heating and cooling degree days or with piecewise linear splines.
